en.topic_title: MTR pledges cooperation with gov’t after reports of underfilled pillars at Tung Chung West Station
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s railway operator, the MTR Corporation, has announced that it will cooperate with a government probe into a construction fault, after local media reported that up to 30 concrete pillars at the new Tung Chung West Station were found to be underfilled.
